text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Conference to be held on July 22 to review economic policies in Lebanon.
- Iranian president reiterates his country's support for Lebanon.
- Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri holds talks in Spain on boosting economic ties.
- Prime Minister Hariri stresses investment opportunites in Lebanon on his visit to Spain.
- Lebanon's trade deficit increased by $600 million in May.
- Lebanon wins first gold medal in Pan Arab Games in Beirut.
- Greek deputy foreign minister to visit Beirut on Thursday.
